test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Blow your own trumpet

options.text: Keep away the dust from your instruments

solution:
The correct answer is "**Boast about one’s own qualities**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**talk boastfully about one's achievements**".
 
• We use the idiom "**blow your own trumpet**" to refer to a person who exaggerates his achievements often to show off among people.
 
 
• **Example**: *My mother said to me, "Don't **blow your own trumpet__** among friends"*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**अपनी उपलब्धियों के बारे में गर्व से बात करें**".
 
• We use the idiom "**अपनी खुद की तुरही बजाओ**" to refer to a person who exaggerates his achievements often to show off among people.
